title: The Deterrence Effects of Tax Whistleblower Laws: Evidence from New York's False Claims Acts
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. The treatment p_NY5 x t_NY interacts a post-2010 indicator (the August 2010 amendment to New York's False Claims Act) with a time-invariant indicator for firms with New York establishments; all treated firms switch at the same date, so there is one cohort (Tables 2-6, Figure 1 Panels A-B, which use year x t_NY interactions around 2009). Table 7 Panels A-B and Figure 1 Panel C use a stacked design (new_obs stacks with fyear#new_obs and estbl_fe#new_obs fixed effects) around New York Attorney General whistleblower press releases; Table 7 Panel C is a state-level single-date DiD; Table 6 is a triple interaction with a continuous ex ante establishment measure. All columns include 9-14 time-varying controls.
design_notes: Firm-year panel of Compustat firms with establishments in New York or neighboring states (main_data_w.dta; YTS establishment data), fiscal years 2005-2014. Table 2 (Table1-4.do line 76): reghdfe tsetr1_pi_t p_NY5##t_NY + controls, absorb(estbl_fe sic2#fyear), vce(cluster estbl_fe) keepsingletons; column 2 adj_tsetr1_pi_t. estbl_fe is the establishment-location fixed effect (state of establishments), i.e. the unit FE is at the state-group level, not the firm. Table 3: triple interactions with lorf_opt_csho_emp5 and ind_reg. Table 4: federal ETR outcomes. Table 5A: tax-bank relationships, Double Irish, SPEs; 5B: income shifting with average foreign tax rate interactions. Table 6: establishment counts (reghdfe and ppmlhdfe) with exante x post x treat. Table 7A-B (Table7_Panel_AB.do): treat_industry##post_fama on appended_event.dta stacks; 7C: state corporate tax collections post##treat with state and year FE and macro controls. Figure 1: xtreg ib2009.fyear##c.t_NY with controls and i.sic2, fe i(estbl_fe).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One treatment date (NY FCA amendment, 2010). Table 7 press-release events are stacked by cohort (new_obs) rather than estimated as an unstacked staggered design.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; time-varying controls; unit FE at establishment-state level
specs.treatment_var: p_NY5##t_NY (components: p_NY5 post-2010; t_NY NY-exposed firm)
specs.treatment_definition: t_NY = 1 for firms with New York establishments (time-invariant); p_NY5 = 1 for fiscal years after the 2010 FCA amendment
specs.unit_var: estbl_fe (establishment-state group); firms identified by gvkey
specs.controls: logsales mtb lev_lt_avgat tlcf_avgat capx_avgat pifo_avgat ib_avgat delaware xidoc_avgat cit sale_fac thbk comb_rep addbk (time-varying firm and state tax-system controls)

specs.treatment_definition: year-specific effects for NY-exposed firms relative to 2009
specs.controls: logsales mtb lev_lt_avgat tlcf_avgat capx_avgat pifo_avgat ib_avgat delaware xidoc_avgat

specs.treatment_definition: industry exposed to an NYAG tax-whistleblower press release (treat_industry) x post-release (post_fama), stacked by event (new_obs)
specs.controls: logsales mtb lev_lt_avgat tlcf_avgat capx_avgat pifo_avgat ib_avgat delaware xidoc_avgat
specs.reported_location: Table 7, Panels A-B (Panel B adds t_NY##p_NY5)
specs.notes: Figure 1 Panel C is the stacked event-study version (xtreg fe i(cohort)).

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; time-varying state controls
specs.treatment_definition: treat = New York (vs neighboring states), post = after 2010

data_access_note: No data files shipped. Sources: YourEconomy Time Series (establishments), Compustat and Compustat Segment, Execucomp, Dealscan, Exhibit 21 subsidiaries, WRDS Subsidiary, Census state tax collections, BEA/BLS; the created files (main_data_w.dta etc.) are referenced but absent. Logs of all tables are included.
software_notes: Stata 18 (reghdfe, ppmlhdfe, xtreg, esttab, outreg2, coefplot, ffind).
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Design read from the README variable table (p_NY5 = Post, t_NY = Treat) and Table1-4.do. Flags cite Baker-Larcker-Wang but no modern estimator is used; the main design is a single-date DiD.
